test_rename_callable: test renaming a Series index using a callable lambda function
test_rename_dict: test renaming a Series index using a dictionary mapping old keys to new keys
test_rename_series: test renaming a Series index using another Series as the renamer
test_rename_set_name: test setting the Series name via rename with a scalar value
test_rename_inplace: test renaming a Series name or index in-place with inplace=True
test_rename_multiindex_level: test renaming a specific level of a MultiIndex on a Series
test_rename_with_axis: test renaming a Series with the axis parameter for compatibility
test_rename_none: test clearing a Series name by passing None to rename
test_rename_partial_dict: test partial dictionary rename preserving unmentioned index labels
test_rename_retain_index_name: test that renaming with an empty dict retains the index name
